chunks: From him, from Faḍālah, from ʿAbd Allāh ibn Sinān, from Abū ʿAbd Allāh عليه السلام, who said:
There is no salat at midday except on the day of al-Jumuʿah.

key_terms.الْجُمُعَةِ: Friday; the day on which the exception applies
key_terms.صَلَاةَ: salat; ritual prayer referred to in the ruling
key_terms.نِصْفَ: middle; indicating the midpoint of the day

ai.seo_question: Is there salat at midday on Friday according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal exception regarding salat at midday, specifying that the ruling differs on Friday. In the chapter context, it indicates the permissibility of performing nawafil before zawal on the day of al-Jumuʿah.
